name: Utro s Ul'jankoj
source: This is a short slice-of-life story from one of Semyon's many loops at the camp. It focuses on a conflict between our protagonist and the energetic, restless Ulyana.
translation: This is a short slice-of-life story from one of Semyon's many loops at the camp. It focuses on a conflict between our protagonist and the energetic, restless Ulyana.
